achievements.description: Buy the Sculpting Tools so you can craft the town table
achievements.hint: Purchase the Sculpting Tools from the World 1 Town shop and use it on the town task board.

achievements.description: Reach the 2nd world, where there's lots of sand... I hate sand...
achievements.hint: Defeat Amarok in World 1 and talk to the Ghost with the Desert Topaz to access World 2.

achievements.description: Reach world 3, the coolest world in the game!
achievements.hint: Defeat Efaunt in World 2 and go through the frozen portal to access World 3.

achievements.description: You've done better than people who ditch after a few hours!
achievements.hint: Level up your character by fighting monsters or gathering resources.

achievements.description: You're easily in the top 50% of players now!
achievements.hint: Continue leveling up your character.

achievements.description: You've done better than most of my IRL friends who totally exist and aren't made up!
achievements.hint: Reach a higher character level milestone.

achievements.description: You're easily in the top 5% now, that's something to be proud of maybe kind of!
achievements.hint: Reach a very high character level milestone.

achievements.description: Your level is so massive it needs three digits! Just 4 more and you'll have a phone number!
achievements.hint: Reach level 100 on a single character.

achievements.description: 10,000 copper coins worth, that's enough to buy 1400 nomwiches!
achievements.hint: Hold 1 Silver Coin in your inventory.

achievements.description: 1,000,000 copper coins worth, that's enough to buy almost 91,000 rolls of Cue Tape!
achievements.hint: Hold 1 Gold Coin in your inventory.

achievements.description: 100,000,000 copper coins worth, that's enough to buy 3.8 million hot dogs!
achievements.hint: Hold 1 Platinum Coin in your inventory.

achievements.description: Contribute 500 GP to your guild, proving you aren't that kid in the school project who lets others do everything!
achievements.hint: Join a Guild and complete daily/weekly tasks to earn and automatically contribute 500 Guild Points.

achievements.description: Contribute 3000 GP to your guild, putting yourself above fellow members who only have the 500 GP achievement!
achievements.hint: Contribute a total of 3,000 GP to your current guild.

achievements.description: Contribute 20000 GP to your guild, which means your probably the best bow-wow in your guild!
achievements.hint: Contribute a total of 20,000 GP to your current guild.

achievements.description: Create your 2nd character, who will probably never be as good as your 1st character.
achievements.hint: Unlock your second character slot by leveling up your first character.

achievements.description: Create your 4th character, who will never appreciate the struggle the earlier characters went through from having no family bonus stats.
achievements.hint: Reach the required total account level to unlock your 4th character slot.

achievements.description: Create your 8th character, who will never get the love and affection you gave your first few characters when making new characters was still special
achievements.hint: Reach the required total account level to unlock your 8th character slot.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Quests on a single character. They're called Quests but they're more like chores tbh
achievements.hint: Complete 25 unique NPC quests on one character. Daily repeating quests don't count.

achievements.description: Complete 75 Quests on a single character. Seriously these are just errands the NPC's didn't wanna do.
achievements.hint: Complete 75 unique NPC quests on one character.

achievements.description: Complete 150 Quests on a single character. The name speaks for itself.
achievements.hint: Complete 150 unique NPC quests on one character. This requires progressing through several worlds.

achievements.description: Collect 10 unique cards. Who knows you may even get a Baba Yaga Rookie Card!
achievements.hint: Loot monster or skilling cards to register 10 unique cards to your collection.

achievements.description: Collect 30 unique cards. If u wanna trade I got some spare Amarok cards!
achievements.hint: Register 30 unique cards to your collection.

achievements.description: Collect 120 unique cards. This basically makes you like, THE guy who does the card stuff!
achievements.hint: Register 120 unique cards to your collection. Bosses, resources, and event cards all count.

achievements.description: Craft the Anvil II expander. More things to craft, yay!
achievements.hint: Purchase the Anvil Tab 2 crafting recipe and produce it at the anvil.

achievements.description: Craft the Anvil III expander. More things to craft, again, yay!
achievements.hint: Purchase the Anvil Tab 3 crafting recipe (from World 2 shop) and produce it.

achievements.description: Defeat the big poop and the giant house with legs!
achievements.hint: Defeat the secret bosses Dr. Defecaus (Sewers) and Baba Yaga (Birch Enclave).

achievements.description: Defeat the big hourglass and the toilet paper guy!
achievements.hint: Defeat Biggie Hours (drop an Hourglass in the desert) and King Doot (summoned by a 3-player party dropping specific items).

achievements.description: If u love me let me go... erm, I mean get a score of 13 in the Spike Minigame
achievements.hint: Enter the hidden Spike Minigame in the Frog area by clicking the secret spot on the top right, and score 13 points.

achievements.description: Reach the top of the Giant Tree, then jump off... wait no don't do that last part.
achievements.hint: Climb through the portal maps in the giant tree (starting from the Slimes) to reach the very top.

achievements.description: Get a score of 103+ in the Mining Minigame, beating the Developer's score!
achievements.hint: Play the Mining Minigame by clicking the icon on a mining node and score at least 103.

achievements.description: Get a score of 141+ in the Choppin' Minigame, beating the Developer's score!
achievements.hint: Play the Chopping Minigame on a tree node and score at least 141.

achievements.description: Get a score of 67+ in the Fishing Minigame, beating the Developer's score!
achievements.hint: Play the Fishing Minigame in World 2 and score at least 67.

achievements.description: Get a score of 128+ in the Catching minigame, beating the Developer's score!
achievements.hint: Play the Catching Minigame on a bug node in World 2 and score at least 128.

achievements.description: Defeat your first Crystal Monster! These have a 1 in 2000 chance to spawn each time you defeat a normal monster.
achievements.hint: Active AFK in any monster zone until a crystal mob spawns and defeat it.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 Crystal Monsters! This could go a couple rounds...
achievements.hint: Equip the Poop card and Crystals 4 dayys card to increase crystal spawn chance while active AFKing.

achievements.description: Defeat 2000 Crystal Monsters to become the Heavyweight Champion of IdleOn!
achievements.hint: Maximize your crystal spawn chance through stamps, cards, and alchemy, and active AFK with high kill-speed classes like Maestro or ES.

achievements.description: Defeat Amarok on Chaotic Difficulty. He's all bark and... well, all bite too honestly.
achievements.hint: Craft or obtain Chaotic Amarok Keys and defeat the chaotic variant in World 1.

achievements.description: Defeat Efaunt on Chaotic Difficulty. Watch out for his new kick attack, and for all his old attacks since they're still deadly!
achievements.hint: Craft or obtain Chaotic Efaunt Keys and defeat the chaotic variant in World 2.

achievements.description: Die to a Green Mushroom.
achievements.hint: Unequip all your armor, weapons, and remove healing food, then let a Green Mushroom kill you.

achievements.description: Craft a Peanut.
achievements.hint: Complete the first quest from the Picnic Stowaway in World 1 to unlock the Peanut recipe, then craft one.

achievements.description: Consume a Golden Jam.
achievements.hint: Finish the daily Picnic Stowaway questline to receive a Golden Jam, then tap/hold it to consume.

achievements.description: Find and interact with the Developer NPC.
achievements.hint: Talk to the Lavaflame2 NPC hidden in the game.

achievements.description: Complete Glumlee's part of the Main Questline
achievements.hint: Complete all of Glumlee's quests in the World 1 town.

achievements.description: Complete the Picnic Stowaway's part of the Main Questline
achievements.hint: Complete the Picnic Stowaway's introductory quests located in the Frog map.

achievements.description: Complete Stiltzcho's part of the Main Questline
achievements.hint: Complete Stiltzcho's introductory quests located in the Spore map.

achievements.description: Choose one of the 3 starting classes, since like there are only 3 starting classes and not 4.
achievements.hint: Reach level 10 and speak to Promotheus to upgrade your Beginner into a Warrior, Archer, or Mage.

achievements.description: Claim 100 hours of AFK Gains. That's like 4 days and a side of fries.
achievements.hint: Let your characters idle and claim the AFK rewards. This counts across all characters.

achievements.description: Claim 2000 hours of AFK Gains. That's like 3 months but not really cuz u have multiple characters.
achievements.hint: Continue claiming AFK gains across your characters.

achievements.description: Claim 30,000 hours of AFK gains. That's like 2 years, but again it's really more like 2 months cuz you have so many peeps in ur squad.
achievements.hint: Create more characters to multiply your AFK hours easily.

achievements.description: Claim 111,000 hours of AFK gains. Jeez, ok that's like an entire year, even with all your character idling to the max lol
achievements.hint: Make sure to max out all character slots and let them idle.

achievements.description: Equip any trophy. Well, almost any trophy, limited-time trophies don't count.
achievements.hint: Complete a full NPC questline or event to get a permanent trophy, and equip it in the trophy slot.

achievements.description: Your level has reached a point where people debate whether or not it is possible!
achievements.hint: Reach a mythically high character level.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 Giant Monsters. You'll learn about these at the Prayer Rock in the Frostbite Tundra town.
achievements.hint: Unlock and equip the Giant Mobs prayer from the World 3 Prayer Rock, then active-kill until 5 giants spawn and defeat them.

achievements.description: Rank up the Explosive Combustion refinery chamber to rank 2.
achievements.hint: Feed the Red Salt crucible in the World 3 Refinery enough materials and power to rank it up to 2.

achievements.description: Beat wave 50 of Wakawaka War without using more than 1 of any specific tower type. So just 1 boulder, 1 freeze, etc...
achievements.hint: Play Wakawaka War worship tower defense ensuring you place exactly 1 of each tower. Do not place duplicates.

achievements.description: Get a Dementia Skull or higher on every mob within World 3 in the Deathnote feature. I probably don't have to specify "or higher" here lol
achievements.hint: Defeat 1 million of every single monster in World 3 to earn Dementia skulls.

achievements.description: Sell items to a shop for exactly 69 coins.
achievements.hint: Calculate the sell value of cheap items and sell an exact amount to yield exactly 69 copper coins.

achievements.description: Defeat both mutant Minibosses: The Dilapidated Slush of World 3, and the Mutated Mush of World 4.
achievements.hint: Use Slushy Skulls in World 3 and Toxic Waste in World 4 to spawn and defeat these minibosses.

achievements.description: Upgrade the 'Nothing' bubble in Alchemy to Level 5.
achievements.hint: In the World 2 Alchemy cauldrons, upgrade the entirely useless 'Nothing' bubble.

achievements.description: Trash 1000 pets. How could you be so heartless, so cold...
achievements.hint: In the World 4 Breeding feature, drag 1000 hatched pets into the trash can.

achievements.description: Reach World 4, the purple world with all the space stuff and things!
achievements.hint: Defeat Chizoar in World 3 and enter the portal to unlock World 4.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Green Mushrooms to unlock the portal to FROGS!
achievements.hint: Simply kill enough Green Mushrooms to open the first portal.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Frogs to unlock the portal to BEANS!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Frogs to proceed to the next map.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Beans to unlock the portal to SLIMES!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Bored Beans to proceed to the next map.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Slimes to unlock the portal to BABY BOAS!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Slimes to proceed to the next map.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Baby Boas to unlock the portal to CARROTMEN!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Baby Boas to proceed to the next map.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Carrotmen to unlock the portal to GLUBLINS!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Carrotmen to proceed to the next map.

achievements.description: Defeat enough Glublins to unlock the portal to THE BOSS!
achievements.hint: Kill enough Glublins to reach the Encroaching Forest boss arena.

achievements.description: Chop 15 yellow sections in a row during the Choppin' Minigame.
achievements.hint: Focus entirely on precision, waiting for the leaf to slow down before clicking.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 500 Copper Ore in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Use split stacks in your inventory to deposit exactly 500 Copper Ore into a single chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 1500 Oak Logs in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 1500 Oak Logs into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Equip the Copper Helmet and Copper Platebody
achievements.hint: Craft and equip these two basic copper armors.

achievements.description: Defeat 250 Wode Boards with at least 1 other party member
achievements.hint: Invite another player into a party on the Wode Boards map and defeat 250 enemies while they are present.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 2,000 Iron Ore in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 2000 Iron Ore into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Defeat all Giga Frogs before any respawn.
achievements.hint: Go to the Giga Frog map with high damage and movement speed to wipe out all frogs within a few seconds.

achievements.description: Defeat Amarok, the stone golem wolf of the Encroaching Forest.
achievements.hint: Use Amarok Keys (earned from daily quests) to enter the arena and defeat the World 1 boss.

achievements.description: Defeat 25,000 slimes in total. This counts kills from all your characters!
achievements.hint: Leave your characters AFK on Slimes.

achievements.description: Equip an Iron Helmet, Iron Chestplate, Iron Pants, and one Iron Tool.
achievements.hint: Craft the full set of Iron gear at the anvil and equip it.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 20,000 Sticks in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Use split stacks to deposit exactly 20,000 Sticks into a storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 20,000 Forest Fibers in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 20,000 Forest Fibers into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Get a score of 25,000 or more in the Dewdrop Colosseum.
achievements.hint: Use Colosseum tickets in World 1 and clear waves as fast as possible. Area-of-effect skills help significantly.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 30,000 Gold Ore in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 30,000 Gold Ore into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Slam on a yellow ore vein in the Mining Minigame, which gives 3 points!
achievements.hint: In the Mining Minigame, time your tap to land the cart precisely on a yellow vein.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 Rats with at least 1 other party member
achievements.hint: Party up with a friend in the Sewer Rats map and defeat 500 of them actively.

achievements.description: Reach the top of the Giant Tree in Blunder Hills
achievements.hint: Navigate up the platforms in the various tree maps until you reach the very top.

achievements.description: Enter the Sewers with no equipment or weapon, and defeat a sewer poop. Don't want to get your stuff dirty after all!
achievements.hint: Unequip everything (including tools) before entering the Sewers and punch a Poop to death.

achievements.description: Defeat Baba Yaga in under 25 seconds after they spawn in the Birch Enclave
achievements.hint: Wait in the Birch Enclave for the hourly spawn (XX:00) and use your strongest burst attacks to kill her quickly.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 200,000 Platinum Ore in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 200,000 Platinum Ore into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Craft 42 golden peanuts, whatever those might be!
achievements.hint: Unlock the Golden Peanut recipe via a quest and craft 42 of them at the anvil.

achievements.description: Equip Golden Helmet, Chestplate, Pants, Shoes, two Golden tools, and the Defenders Dignity ring.
achievements.hint: Craft all the golden equipment and the Defenders Dignity ring at the anvil, then equip them all simultaneously.

achievements.description: Equip all 4 pieces of Amarok armor.
achievements.hint: Farm Amarok for Grandma Disguise (or craft the helmet) and Amarok slabs, craft the full Amarok set, and equip it.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 500,000 Veiny Logs in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 500,000 Veiny Logs into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Equip the Blunder Hero Trophy, while also having another in your inventory.
achievements.hint: Complete the final Token quest in World 1 on two different characters to receive two Blunder Hero trophies.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 1,000,000 Void Ore in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 1,000,000 Void Ore into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Have exactly 777 coins or roll three 7s.
achievements.hint: A luck-based achievement. Can often be manipulated by calculating coin drops or shop selling.

achievements.description: Stand at the highest point in World 1.
achievements.hint: Climb up to the topmost branch in the Giant Tree maps and stand at the edge.

achievements.description: Find the secret hidden area in World 1.
achievements.hint: Locate the hidden portal in the Frog map (top right platform).

achievements.description: Score a point in the Choppin' Minigame while the leaf is ZOOMING!!!
achievements.hint: Wait for the leaf to reach its absolute fastest speed during the Choppin' minigame and successfully tap it.

achievements.description: Say 'Hi' to 250 different people without closing the game.
achievements.hint: Go to a crowded server (like Server 1 town) and type 'Hi' in the chat, aiming it at many different players in one session.

achievements.description: Reach The Roots, which is the map below the Sticks monsters in the Giant Tree
achievements.hint: Go to the Sticks map in the Giant Tree and drop down into the bottom portal.

achievements.description: Deal 100 or more damage in a single hit in any party dungeon.
achievements.hint: Collect weapon items and damage-boosting RNG items in the Grandfrogger dungeon to hit a 100+ damage attack.

achievements.description: Defeat Grandfrogger on his 1st Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the first stage of the boss at the end of the World 1 party dungeon.

achievements.description: Defeat Grandfrogger on his 2nd Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the second stage of Grandfrogger in the party dungeon by throwing its drops into the cauldron.

achievements.description: Defeat Grandfrogger on his 3rd Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the third stage of Grandfrogger in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Spawn Grandfrogger within 2 minutes of entering the dungeon.
achievements.hint: In a coordinated party, rush clearing the dungeon maps and dropping monster parts into the cauldron as fast as possible.

achievements.description: Defeat Grandfrogger on his 4th Difficulty, and avoid becoming one with the soup...
achievements.hint: Defeat the very difficult fourth stage of Grandfrogger in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Pass through the small golden hoop in the Catching Minigame. It's worth 3 points!
achievements.hint: In the Catching Minigame, precisely tap to navigate your net through the rare, smaller golden hoop.

achievements.description: Level up the 'Hammer Hammer' Alchemy bubble to Lv. 10
achievements.hint: In the World 2 Alchemy feature, upgrade the specific 'Hammer Hammer' bubble (Green/Archer cauldron) to level 10.

achievements.description: Say 'Hi' to 100 unique people without closing the game or changing Servers.
achievements.hint: Stand in a populated town hub and type 'Hi' continuously until 100 different players are near.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 1500 Goldfish in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 1500 Goldfish into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 2500 Flies in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 2500 Flies into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 15 Glass Shards in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 15 Glass Shards (dropped by Sandy Pots) into your storage chest.

achievements.description: Leave one of your players AFK for an entire week, which is 168 hours! Anything more counts too!
achievements.hint: Do not log into a specific character for 7 consecutive days (168 hours).

achievements.description: Get 3 vials to Lv. 4, which are the green ones
achievements.hint: Upgrade any 3 Alchemy Vials in World 2 to the green tier (Level 4).

achievements.description: Choose a subclass for two of your characters.
achievements.hint: Reach the subclass requirements on two different characters and upgrade them at Promotheus.

achievements.description: Have 10 Silver Obols equipped at once. The Family tab counts here!
achievements.hint: Collect or upgrade to Silver Obols and place 10 of them across your Personal and Family Obol pages.

achievements.description: Complete 75 unique quests on a single character. I'm not sure what B-o-B stands for either...
achievements.hint: Progress through various NPC storylines to reach 75 unique completed quests.

achievements.description: Catch a total of 1000 fish across all Fishing Minigame plays.
achievements.hint: Play the Fishing Minigame repeatedly until you have cumulatively caught 1000 fish inside the minigame.

achievements.description: Level up the 'FMJ' Alchemy bubble to Lv. 30
achievements.hint: Upgrade the FMJ (Orange/Warrior cauldron) Alchemy bubble to level 30.

achievements.description: Defeat 250,000 Sandy Pots combined across all characters. Forget the Pillars of Salt though.
achievements.hint: Check your Deathnote or card screen to track total Sandy Pot kills and grind them with AFK characters.

achievements.description: Get 6 vials to Lv. 7, which are the pink ones
achievements.hint: Invest resources into 6 Alchemy Vials until they reach the pink tier (Level 7).

achievements.description: Level up cards for Mafioso, Sandcastle, Pincermin, and Mashed Potato, all up to 1 star.
achievements.hint: Farm these specific World 2 desert monsters until you collect enough of their cards to upgrade them to 1 star.

achievements.description: Run from Town to Efaunt's Tomb in under 2 minutes. No teleporting using the World Map.
achievements.hint: Use movement speed potions or skills, avoid fighting, and rush map-to-map manually from the World 2 Town to Efaunt's Tomb.

achievements.description: Have 15 Golden Obols equipped at once. The Family tab counts here!
achievements.hint: Combine Obols in the Alchemy lab until you have 15 gold tier Obols, and equip them across your Personal/Family pages.

achievements.description: Defeat 160 Sand Giants within 10 minutes of entering the map. Auto must be off.
achievements.hint: Enter the Sand Giant map and manually kill 160 of them quickly. High damage AoE classes work best.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 6000 Jellyfish in your Storage Chest. I heard their Jelly goes good with burgers btw.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 6000 Jellyfish (from fishing) into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 50,000 Sentient Cereal in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 50,000 Sentient Cereal into an empty slot in your storage chest.

achievements.description: Get a Score of 200,000 or more in the Sandstone Colosseum
achievements.hint: Use tickets in the World 2 Colosseum and rapidly clear waves. Use an active class with massive AoE.

achievements.description: Use 101 silver pens in the Post Office
achievements.hint: Collect Silver Pens from monster drops and use 101 of them to manually refresh Post Office orders.

achievements.description: Pass through the teenie tiny Lava hoop in the Catching Minigame. It only appears if you go through 25 hoops in a row!
achievements.hint: Maintain a flawless streak of 25 hoops in the Catching minigame to spawn the tiny lava hoop, then carefully pass through it.

achievements.description: Level up the 'Smarty Boi' Alchemy bubble to Lv. 50
achievements.hint: Upgrade the Smarty Boi (Purple/Mage cauldron) Alchemy bubble to level 50.

achievements.description: Have the YumYum Sheriff trophy equipped, while also having another in your inventory.
achievements.hint: Complete the final World 2 Token quest on two different characters to receive two YumYum Sheriff trophies.

achievements.description: Kill Crabbycakes manually, without Auto on, until one drops a Nuget Cake. Good luck...
achievements.hint: Turn off auto-attack entirely. Manually click/tap to attack Crabbycakes until the extremely rare Nuget Cake drops. Stack drop rate modifiers before attempting.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 100,000 Bloaches in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 100,000 Bloaches (caught from fishing) into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Get 10 vials to Lv. 9, which are the hyperlight Orange ones. Stop focusing so much on vials, it's not healthy!
achievements.hint: Heavily invest resources into 10 Alchemy Vials to reach the hyperlight Orange tier (Level 9).

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 1,000,000 Fruit Flies in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 1,000,000 Fruit Flies (from catching) into an empty storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Wear the Efaunt helmet, Ribcage, Hipillium, and Ankles. Also have 1 Efaunt Obol equipped.
achievements.hint: Farm Efaunt extensively to craft the full Efaunt armor set and obtain an Efaunt Obol, then equip them all.

achievements.description: Fall off a high place or specific map edge.
achievements.hint: Jump or fall from a specific high point in the game that triggers this Waluigi-style scream reference.

achievements.description: Obtain a Bobjoepickle.
achievements.hint: Purchase a Bobjoepickle from the World 2 Alchemy Shop (it requires extreme luck for it to appear/be affordable).

achievements.description: Fail to catch fish for an extended period.
achievements.hint: Equip the worst possible fishing rod/bait combination and fish to guarantee a string of failures.

achievements.description: Achieve high skill levels to unlock Maestro.
achievements.hint: Complete the long hidden questline starting with the Goldric NPC to unlock the Maestro secret class.

achievements.description: Defeat Snakenhotep on his 1st Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the first form of the boss in the World 2 party dungeon.

achievements.description: Defeat Snakenhotep on his 2nd Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the second form of Snakenhotep in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Defeat Snakenhotep on his 3rd Difficulty.
achievements.hint: Defeat the third form of Snakenhotep in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Wazam 125 rooms in Snakenhotep's Dungeon by performing exceptionally well in a room.
achievements.hint: In the World 2 party dungeon, complete the room objectives extremely fast and flawlessly to trigger a 'Wazam!' rating 125 times.

achievements.description: Pass 30 rooms in Snakenhotep's Dungeon by doing the thingy the room says to do.
achievements.hint: Clear 30 rooms in the World 2 dungeon.

achievements.description: Deal 1000 or more damage in a single hit within any Dungeon.
achievements.hint: Stack damage upgrades and specialized weapons in any party dungeon to hit 1,000+ damage.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 250 Doge -I mean froge- critters in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Use Trapping to capture exactly 250 Froges and deposit them in an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 1,000 Forest Souls in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Use Worship to gather exactly 1,000 Forest Souls and deposit them in an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Checkout a total of 1000 talent books from the Talent Book Library.
achievements.hint: Regularly check out books from the Talent Book Library in the World 3 Town. This will take a long time to accumulate.

achievements.description: Have 4 unclaimed Yellow Cogs during any single moment in time, apart from March 16, 2026 at 3.07pm
achievements.hint: Produce Cogs on your Construction board and intentionally leave 4 Yellow Cogs uncollected.

achievements.description: Get a Copper Skull or higher on every Blunder Hills monster in the Deathnote.
achievements.hint: Defeat 10,000 of every World 1 (Blunder Hills) monster to register Copper Skulls in the Deathnote.

achievements.description: You're gonna kill all them lil' poofs? You monster... well, at least make it quick, like 20s or less after entering the map.
achievements.hint: Enter the Sheepie/Poof map and completely clear all of them within 20 seconds.

achievements.description: Have 4 Prayers in your Prayer Rock thingy. You get Prayers by placing these wizard dudes into towers and stuff and kickin' butt!
achievements.hint: Unlock 4 different prayers from playing Worship Tower Defense minigames, and equip them on the Prayer Rock.

achievements.description: Beat wave 50 in Glublin Gorefest using ONLY Boulder Roller wizards. No freeze, no confetti, just boulder.
achievements.hint: In the World 1 Worship tower defense, only build Boulder Rollers and survive up to wave 50.

achievements.description: Have 20 Grey Cogs placed on the board at once. Not sure why this is an achievement, cogs are boring.
achievements.hint: Produce and place 20 basic Grey Cogs onto your Construction board at the same time.

achievements.description: Upgrade buildings in construction a total of 50 times. Any buildings, utilities, wizards, shrines, they all count!
achievements.hint: Upgrade any combination of structures on your construction board 50 times total.

achievements.description: Upgrade buildings in construction a total of 250 times.
achievements.hint: Upgrade any combination of structures on your construction board 250 times total.

achievements.description: Manually loot 1000 floof poofs, then 1000 melty cubes, then 1000 moustache combs. So 3000 in total!
achievements.hint: Turn off auto-loot if you have it. You must manually pick up 1000 of each of these World 3 drops in order.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 Giant Mobs of each type; Bloque, Mamooth, Snowman, Penguin, then Thermister, IN THAT ORDER. So 25 in total!
achievements.hint: Equip the Giant Mobs prayer and active-kill in specific maps to spawn 5 giants per map, strictly in the stated order.

achievements.description: Get a Golden Skull or higher on every YumYum Desert monster in the Deathnote.
achievements.hint: Defeat 250,000 of every World 2 (YumYum Desert) monster to register Golden Skulls in the Deathnote.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 10,000 Dune Souls in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Gather exactly 10,000 Dune Souls via Worship and place them into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Remember all those pens you lent out in school and never got back? You've got 13 seconds to vent your anger on every penguin mob!
achievements.hint: Enter the Penguin map and clear all enemies completely within 13 seconds.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 60,000 Mouseys in your Storage Chest. Imagine the noise in that chest of yours... or even the smell, ugh.
achievements.hint: Trap exactly 60,000 Mousey critters and place them into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have 40 Yellow Cogs placed on the board at once. Alright now I see how this is achievement worthy, cogs are kinda neat.
achievements.hint: Produce and place 40 Yellow Cogs onto your Construction board at the same time.

achievements.description: Rank up the Spontaneous Combustion refinery chamber to Rank 3.
achievements.hint: Fuel the Orange Salt crucible in the World 3 Refinery to rank it up to 3.

achievements.description: Rank up the Redox Combustion refinery chamber to Rank 10.
achievements.hint: Fuel the primary Red Salt crucible in the World 3 Refinery over a long period to reach rank 10.

achievements.description: Upgrade buildings in construction a total of 900 times.
achievements.hint: Upgrade any combination of structures on your construction board 900 times total.

achievements.description: Have 16 unclaimed Grey Cogs at once. Jeez, I'm glad anthropomorphic cogs aren't real.
achievements.hint: Produce Cogs on your board but intentionally leave 16 basic Grey Cogs uncollected.

achievements.description: 78 Cogs. All purple cogs. Did I say cogs are great? I think cogs are great. Cog cog cog!
achievements.hint: Produce and place 78 Purple Cogs on your Construction board at the same time.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 250,000 Rooted Souls in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Gather exactly 250,000 Rooted Souls via Worship and place them into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Beat wave 50 of Acorn Assault with just 4 towers active. Place down a 5th tower at any time, and it wont count!
achievements.hint: Play the Acorn Assault tower defense using only 4 towers total, upgrading them highly to survive.

achievements.description: Have a HONK of exactly 1,000,000 Honkers in your HONK Chest. HONKHONKHONK HOOOONK!!!
achievements.hint: Use Trapping to capture exactly 1,000,000 Honker critters and place them into a chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 500 Black Lenses in your Storage Chest. Better complete this before I make it 1,000!
achievements.hint: Farm Sheepies until you get exactly 500 Black Lenses and deposit them into your chest.

achievements.description: Defeat every Bloodbone in just 12 seconds after entering the map. Wow, wild.
achievements.hint: Enter the Bloodbone map with a high-AoE class (like Elemental Sorcerer or Divine Knight) and wipe them out immediately.

achievements.description: Get a Score of 2,500,000 or more in the Chillsnap Colosseum
achievements.hint: Use a World 3 Colosseum ticket and clear the waves fast for a huge score.

achievements.description: Deal 25000 or more damage in a single hit within any Dungeon.
achievements.hint: Stack extreme damage buffs and powerful weapons in a party dungeon run to land a hit over 25k.

achievements.description: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 1st difficulty
achievements.hint: Defeat the first stage of the boss in the World 3 party dungeon.

achievements.description: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 2nd difficulty
achievements.hint: Defeat the second stage of Glaciaxus in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 3rd difficulty
achievements.hint: Defeat the third stage of Glaciaxus in the party dungeon.

achievements.description: Complete 1000 jobs within the Glacial Basement dungeon.
achievements.hint: Over many runs in the World 3 party dungeon, complete the randomized tasks assigned by the statues.

achievements.description: Find the Equinox Mirror drop from Bloodbones, a 1 in 1000 drop, and use it to visit the Equinox Valley.
achievements.hint: Farm Bloodbones in World 3 until they drop the Equinox Mirror, then use it to access the Equinox challenges.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 75,000 TV remotes in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Farm TV Remotes from the World 4 enemies and deposit exactly 75,000 into a single storage chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 800,000 Bottle Caps in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 800,000 Bottle Caps (from catching) into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 10,000,000 Wriggly Balls in your Storage Chest. Green Stack bro!
achievements.hint: A green stack requires 10 million. Deposit exactly 10,000,000 Wriggly Balls into your storage chest.

achievements.description: Accumulate 8760 hours, or an entire year, of Lab AFK time across all players.
achievements.hint: Leave your characters in the World 4 Lab until their cumulative time spent equals a full year.

achievements.description: Cook a meal with no spices.
achievements.hint: Try to discover a new meal in World 4 Cooking using absolutely no spices.

achievements.description: Get a Breedability III heart on at least 2 Pets within the nest.
achievements.hint: In World 4 Breeding, breed pets until the breedability modifier hits level III on two separate pets.

achievements.description: Get a Breedability VII heart on at least 15 pets within the nest.
achievements.hint: Breed pets heavily until 15 different pets have reached a breedability level of VII.

achievements.description: Have 6 bronze (or rarer) eggs in your nest at the same time, waiting to be hatched!
achievements.hint: Upgrade your eggs in World 4 Breeding and let them accumulate until you have 6 bronze or better eggs ready.

achievements.description: Have 12 gold (or rarer) eggs in your nest at the same time, waiting to be hatched!
achievements.hint: Highly upgrade your egg rarity rate and let them pile up until you have 12 gold or better eggs.

achievements.description: Fail a pet battle with the enemy team having only 5% HP or less. Wait, barely it's spelled HOW???
achievements.hint: Purposely set up a very close pet battle in the Arena or Foraging and lose when the enemy is almost dead.

achievements.description: Have 5 kitchens all cooking cabbages at the same time. Remember gamers, eat your vegetables, they ain't so bad!
achievements.hint: Unlock at least 5 kitchens in World 4 and set them all to cook Cabbages simultaneously.

achievements.description: Have 8 kitchens all cooking Pretzels at the same time. Don't get it twisted, them pretzels are the real deal.
achievements.hint: Unlock at least 8 kitchens in World 4 and set them all to cook Pretzels simultaneously.

achievements.description: Upgrade any kitchen stat to Lv. 300, giving you an elite crown over the upgrade bars, thus resulting in dopamine.
achievements.hint: Invest extreme amounts of coins/resources into upgrading a single Kitchen stat (like Speed) to level 300.

achievements.description: Have a speed of 'Too Fast' displayed while cooking an Eggplant. No this is not a metaphor.
achievements.hint: Raise your cooking speed incredibly high so that when you try to cook Eggplants, the time displays as 'Too Fast'.

achievements.description: Complete all constellations in the Hyperion Nebula. Thats what world 4 is called btw.
achievements.hint: Check the Telescope in World 1 or 4 and fulfill all the requirements for every World 4 star constellation.

achievements.description: Claim 25 chips from the Chip Repository. I was gonna make this 250 chips, but people from the future told me not to.
achievements.hint: Purchase 25 chips total from the Lab's Chip Repository (rotates weekly).

achievements.description: Claim spices by any means 10,000 times. Like, individual claims.
achievements.hint: Spam click to claim spices in the Foraging menu, or let pets gather for a very long time.

achievements.description: Upgrade a meal at the Dinner Menu to the point where it gets a diamond plate!
achievements.hint: Upgrade any meal to level 11 to obtain the Diamond Plate.

achievements.description: Upgrade a meal at the Dinner Menu to the point where it gets a purple plate!
achievements.hint: Upgrade any meal to level 30 to obtain the Purple Plate.

achievements.description: Upgrade a meal at the Dinner Menu to the point where it gets a void pearl plate!
achievements.hint: Upgrade any meal to an extremely high level (50+) to unlock the Void Pearl plate.

achievements.description: Dance with at least 5 other people while you're all in World 4 town!
achievements.hint: Gather in World 4 town on a crowded server and type '/dance' with 5 other players simultaneously.

achievements.description: Get a Score of 10,000,000 or more in the Astro Colosseum
achievements.hint: Use a World 4 Colosseum ticket and clear the waves extremely fast with high Area-of-Effect classes.

achievements.description: Beat wave 50 of Clash of Cans with 3 Poisonic Elders at Lv 5 or higher. Also, you can't sell towers.
achievements.hint: Play the Clash of Cans tower defense, build three Poisonic Elders, upgrade them to Lv 5, and win wave 50 without selling anything.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 1 million Orb Kills.
achievements.hint: Use the Divine Knight class and repeatedly active-farm maps using the Divine Knight's Orb skill to rack up kills.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 1 million Plunderous Kills. This one is the true challenge of the three.
achievements.hint: Use the Siege Breaker class and active-farm maps where Plunderous Mobs spawn from the flag to rack up kills.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 1 million Wormhole Kills.
achievements.hint: Use the Elemental Sorcerer class and active-farm maps, destroying mobs spawned out of the Wormhole.

achievements.description: Destruction comes to all who cross your path, no matter how many times you cross paths.
achievements.hint: Complete the 'True King', 'True Pirate', and 'True Emperor' achievements by mastering the active skills of all three elite classes.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 200,000 Maple Logs in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 200,000 Maple Logs (chopped in W5) into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 5,000,000 Orange Slices in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 5,000,000 Orange Slices (dropped by World 5 Oranges) into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 100,000,000 Mongo Worm Slices in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 100,000,000 Mongo Worm Slices (dropped by World 5 Worms) into an empty chest slot. Green stack!

achievements.description: Reach level 300 on any character! My oh my! This would have been inconceivable just a few years ago!
achievements.hint: Level up one character to level 300. XP modifiers, alchemy, and high-level World 5/6 farming are necessary.

achievements.description: Complete all constellations in the Smolderin' Plateau. You can check your progress within the Telescope.
achievements.hint: Check the Telescope in town and fulfill all requirements for every World 5 star constellation.

achievements.description: Reach World 5, a personal favorite world of mine! Look, I like lava what can I say.
achievements.hint: Defeat Troll in World 4 and enter the portal to unlock World 5.

achievements.description: Reach Wave 50 of Citric Conflict tower defence without placing a single Kraken Towers. Not even one.
achievements.hint: Play the Citric Conflict tower defense relying on Party Starters, Poisonic Elders, and Boulder Rollers.

achievements.description: Collect 15 Artifacts from Sailing
achievements.hint: Send ships to islands in World 5 Sailing to discover 15 distinct artifacts.

achievements.description: Collect all 30 Artifacts from Sailing
achievements.hint: Unlock and explore all islands in World 5 Sailing to find all 30 base artifacts.

achievements.description: Collect all 30 ANCIENT Artifacts from Sailing. All that glitters is not gold, but it sure is shiny!
achievements.hint: Keep searching islands you've already found artifacts on to upgrade all 30 artifacts to Ancient (Gold) tier.

achievements.description: Upgrade a boat to Lv 100 in Sailing. It'll turn gold to reflect its power!
achievements.hint: Spend materials upgrading the speed/loot stats of a single boat in World 5 Sailing until it reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Upgrade a boat to Lv 300 in Sailing. This is the pinnacle of naval prowess, it doesn't get fancier than this!
achievements.hint: Continue upgrading a single boat in World 5 Sailing heavily until it hits level 300.

achievements.description: Unlock the 3rd Divinity God.
achievements.hint: Gain enough Divinity points in World 5 to unlock Nobisect, the 3rd god.

achievements.description: Unlock the 7th Divinity God.
achievements.hint: Gain enough Divinity points to unlock Purrmep, the 7th god.

achievements.description: Unlock the 10th and final Divinity God.
achievements.hint: Gain enough Divinity points to unlock Bagur, the 10th god.

achievements.description: Get a POiNG score of 25,000 or more! My personal highscore is 38,323 at the time of coding this!
achievements.hint: Play the hidden POiNG minigame in World 5 (accessed via the Gaming interface or specific secret) and score at least 25,000.

achievements.description: Harvest a plant with a Bit worth who's first 3 digits are 777. For example, 77.7K Bits would count, or 777M Bits too!
achievements.hint: A luck-based achievement in World 5 Gaming. Keep harvesting plants until the value lands exactly on a 777 sequence.

achievements.description: Harvest a total of 1000 Chemical-type Plants in Gaming.
achievements.hint: Unlock the Chemical plant mutation in World 5 Gaming and harvest 1000 of them over time.

achievements.description: Harvest a total of 500 Voraci-type Plants in Gaming.
achievements.hint: Unlock the Voraci plant mutation in World 5 Gaming and harvest 500 of them over time.

achievements.description: Harvest a total of 100 Bonsai-type Plants in Gaming.
achievements.hint: Unlock the Bonsai plant mutation in World 5 Gaming and harvest 100 of them.

achievements.description: Make a trade with Blobby G worth a gold bar amount that starts with 777, like 777K or 7.77M for example. PS; 776 and 778 work too lol
achievements.hint: Manipulate your Sailing loot and check the daily trades with Blobby G to find or create one that hits the 777 gold bar threshold.

achievements.description: Buy all 20 Boats in Sailing. Uh, yea, there is a scroll bar below the boats, you can buy more than 5 boats
achievements.hint: Unlock and purchase all 20 available boats from the World 5 Sailing dock.

achievements.description: On your Divine Knight, get an Orb Score of 400 or more on OJ Bay. This is the number above your Orb!
achievements.hint: Go to OJ Bay, pop your Divine Knight Orb skill, and use high-speed clearing methods to score over 400 before it expires.

achievements.description: On your Siege Breaker, get a Flag Score of 150 or more on Erruption River. This is the number above your Flag!
achievements.hint: Go to Erruption River on your Siege Breaker, place your flag, and kill enemies fast enough to reach 150 score.

achievements.description: On your Elemental Sorcerer, get a Wormhole Score of 83 or more on Niagrilled Falls. This is the number above your Wormhole!
achievements.hint: Go to Niagrilled Falls on your Elemental Sorcerer, use the Wormhole skill, and clear fast enough to hit a score of 83.

achievements.description: Defeat Kattlecruk while unequipped of all armor and weapons.
achievements.hint: Unequip your armor and weapon before defeating the World 5 boss, Kattlecruk. You can weaken him first, then swap gear before the final blow.

achievements.description: Steal an item.
achievements.hint: Relates to the World 5 Shop mechanics. Potentially interacting with or acquiring a specific item in a cheeky way.

achievements.description: Fail a minigame instantly or rapidly.
achievements.hint: In a World 5 minigame, fail immediately upon starting it multiple times.

achievements.description: Get a Lava Skull or higher on every Smolderin' Plateau monster in the Deathnote. Yea, the 100M Kill Skull. This is gonna take a while.
achievements.hint: Defeat 100 million of every single monster in World 5. This requires immense multikill multipliers.

achievements.description: Level up a Sailing Captain to Lv 15. Few captains in the universe can rival their ability to plunder!
achievements.hint: Keep sending a specific captain on voyages in World 5 Sailing until they reach level 15.

achievements.description: Level up a Sailing Captain to Lv 10. They shall sail the seas with confidence!
achievements.hint: Keep sending a specific captain on voyages in World 5 Sailing until they reach level 10.

achievements.description: Reach World 6, the Spirited Valley! You'll love it here, all the spirits are very friendly!
achievements.hint: Defeat Kattlecruk in World 5 and go through the portal to unlock World 6.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 250,000 Ladybugs in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 250,000 Ladybugs (from catching) into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 5,000,000 Effervescent Logs in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 5,000,000 Effervescent Logs (chopped in W6) into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have a stack of exactly 100,000,000 Royal Headpiece in your Storage Chest.
achievements.hint: Deposit exactly 100,000,000 Royal Headpiece monster drops into an empty chest slot.

achievements.description: Have exactly 1337 Lanterns in your inventory.
achievements.hint: Deposit or manage your inventory to hold exactly 1,337 Lanterns from World 6.

achievements.description: Get an overgrowth of 32x on a single crop.
achievements.hint: Let a plant sit on your World 6 Farming plot until its overgrowth multiplier reaches exactly or surpasses 32x.

achievements.description: Get an overgrowth of 1,024x on a single crop.
achievements.hint: Unlock the higher overgrowth limits in Farming and wait for a crop to hit 1,024x.

achievements.description: Get an overgrowth of 8,192x on a single crop.
achievements.hint: Max out overgrowth capabilities and let a crop sit for a very long time to reach 8,192x.

achievements.description: Have 10,000 or more Apple crops in your Depot at once. You can lock the first crop before it grows to guarantee an apple!
achievements.hint: Grow and harvest Apples in World 6 Farming until your depot holds 10,000.

achievements.description: Have 1,000,000 or more Corn crops in your Depot at once. Mmmm, Corn!
achievements.hint: Grow and harvest Corn in World 6 Farming until your depot holds 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Find 30 unique crops, as shown by the Crop Scientist!
achievements.hint: Use Magic Beans and upgrades to unlock 30 different crop mutations.

achievements.description: Find 70 unique crops, as shown by the Crop Scientist!
achievements.hint: Use Magic Beans and upgrades to unlock 70 different crop mutations.

achievements.description: Find 110 unique crops, as shown by the Crop Scientist!
achievements.hint: Use Magic Beans and upgrades to unlock 110 different crop mutations.

achievements.description: Fill every single plot with the exact same crop.
achievements.hint: Lock in one specific seed for every plot on your World 6 Farm until they all match.

achievements.description: Make a crop trade with the Legumulyte worth exactly 777 magic beans.
achievements.hint: Check the Magic Bean trades daily and try to set up an exact trade of 777.

achievements.description: Get 27 plots of land in your farm.
achievements.hint: Unlock maximum plots on your World 6 farm by purchasing expansions with Magic Beans.

achievements.description: Reach the Sneaking Floor with the Petrified Ceramist guest.
achievements.hint: Climb up the floors in World 6 Sneaking until you encounter the Petrified Ceramist.

achievements.description: Reach what seems like the top Floor of Sneaking with the Eldar Kingulyte guest.
achievements.hint: Reach the highest available floors in the Sneaking building.

achievements.description: Untie 6 other Ninja Twins.
achievements.hint: Find and untie 6 Ninja Twins while exploring the floors in Sneaking.

achievements.description: Successfully find 6 items in a row, in a single AFK claim within Sneaking.
achievements.hint: Equip high find-chance items and leave your ninjas to idle, claiming when they are likely to succeed 6 steals back-to-back.

achievements.description: Find a +50 Yellow Belt Sneaking Charm. Yes, exactly +50.
achievements.hint: Loot charms in Sneaking until you get a Yellow Belt that provides exactly +50 to its stat.

achievements.description: Equip the Straw Hat or stack buffs.
achievements.hint: Relates to finding/equipping the Straw Hat related to World 6 mechanics.

achievements.description: Get a Bloomy Summoning Familiar.
achievements.hint: In World 6 Summoning, successfully summon a Bloomy familiar.

achievements.description: Get a Regalis Summoning Familiar.
achievements.hint: In World 6 Summoning, successfully summon a rare Regalis familiar.

achievements.description: Survive for 5 minutes in The King's Gambit. Find this feature in Cavern 14 of the Hole in world 5.
achievements.hint: Access the King's Gambit mode via the World 5 hole caverns and use defensive/stall tactics to survive 5 minutes.

achievements.description: Get 10 Career Wins within Summoning
achievements.hint: Win 10 matches in the Summoning battles.

achievements.description: Get 25 Career Wins within Summoning
achievements.hint: Win 25 matches in the Summoning battles.

achievements.description: Get 58 Career Wins within Summoning
achievements.hint: Win 58 matches in the Summoning battles.

achievements.description: Reach Wave 50 in Breezy Battle without placing more than 5 Towers in total.
achievements.hint: Play the Breezy Battle tower defense using only 5 towers max, prioritizing powerful upgrades over volume.

achievements.description: Complete all constellations in the Spirited Valley. You can check your progress within the Telescope.
achievements.hint: Check the Telescope in town and fulfill all requirements for every World 6 star constellation.

achievements.description: Add 5 different golden foods to The Beanstalk.
achievements.hint: Collect the required base amount (usually 10,000) of 5 different Golden Foods to store them in the Beanstalk.

achievements.description: Find or interact with the Giant Hampter.
achievements.hint: Breed or discover the secret Giant Hampter pet/summon.

achievements.description: Defeat a specific spirit challenge.
achievements.hint: Defeat the ghost/spirit enemy in World 6.

achievements.description: Add 14 different golden foods to The Beanstalk.
achievements.hint: Collect the required base amount (usually 10,000) of 14 different Golden Foods to store them in the Beanstalk.

achievements.description: Get a Lava Skull or higher on every Spirited Valley monster in the Deathnote.
achievements.hint: Defeat 100 million of every single monster in World 6.

achievements.description: Receive a hug from Timmy.
achievements.hint: Secret achievement relating to the World 5 or World 6 NPC interactions, possibly requiring a specific item drop.
